mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies with a temperature of 68 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under a new moon.

City Hall reminds residents that road construction is slated for Highway M beginning August 18, with traffic shifts occurring to accommodate utility work. Also, check out the various election notices posted on the city website regarding the upcoming primaries.

We have a busy schedule today with yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, plus the Cave Carnival this Sunday.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 5, officers located a man on Whalen Road who was wanted for a probation violation warrant and took him into custody after he attempted to flee.
You can enjoy the delicious Devil's Food Cake flavor today when the shop opens at 10 AM.
